official_identifier.why: The stored session law gives Public Law 2025, chapter 294 and section 1500-Y. The official Maine Revised Statutes page (not stored) now codifies it as 10 M.R.S. section 1500-DD in chapter 241, with the history note 'PL 2025, c. 294, sec. 1 (NEW). RR 2025, c. 1, Pt. A, sec. 16 (RAL)'. The record's '10 M.R.S. 1500-Y' is the bill's section number, not the current citation.

summary_claims.claim: A person may not use an AI chatbot in trade or commerce in a way that may mislead a consumer into believing it is a human unless clearly notified
A violation is a violation of the Maine Unfair Trade Practices Act

newer_versions.what: Codified text at 10 M.R.S. section 1500-DD (renumbered from 1500-Y by the Revisor)

note: Newer form on an official site: legislature.maine.gov/statutes/10/title10sec1500-DD-1.html shows the Act codified as section 1500-DD after revisor renumbering.
